summary: The Marygold Companies (NYSE American: MGLD) filed an 8-K disclosing a September 25, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Flower AcquireCo, LLC, controlled by Madison Dearborn Partners funds, and its subsidiary Flower Merger Sub, Inc. Merger Sub will merge into Marygold, which survives as a wholly owned MDP subsidiary, for $2.00 per share cash, roughly a 100% premium to the September 24, 2026 close. Preferred converts at the same per-share price; in-the-money options cash out, out-of-the-money options and warrants cancel. MDP committed equity, no financing condition. Watch HSR/regulatory clearance, shareholder vote, and any superior proposals given the large premium.
